name: otp-paste-input
title: OTP Paste Input
description: One-time-code field that extracts the code from a pasted SMS or email, skipping phone numbers, amounts, account endings and order numbers (a run near "code" or "OTP" wins), and accepts digits typed or pasted in any script (full-width, Devanagari, Arabic-Indic).

meta.summary: Pulls the right one-time code out of a whole pasted SMS or email, ignoring phone numbers and amounts, and accepts digits in any script.
meta.server: Verify the code server-side with expiry, attempt limits and rate limiting.
catches: Whole SMS or email pasted instead of just the code
Phone numbers, amounts, account endings and order numbers mistaken for the code
Full-width, Devanagari or Arabic-Indic digits from other keyboards
limits: Picks the likeliest code; unusual message formats can still confuse it
Doesn't verify the code; your server does
a11y: Visible label; input is described by a polite notice region
Digit boxes are a visual layer marked aria-hidden over one real input
